# Hashlist fixtures

| --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `421ab9ff-ed7f-4c0b-9f66-ee91f12d57eb.fragment.txt` | The `#fragment` of the iframe in `https://hashlists.debridmediamanager.com/421ab9ff-ed7f-4c0b-9f66-ee91f12d57eb.html`, fetched 2026-09-29 22:48 UTC, byte for byte.                                                                                                                                                                           | A user reported a white page on it. 1,981,609 characters of lz-string that decode to "Aster's hashlist": 27,991 torrents, 27,784 once blocked hashes and year-less movies drop out. At that size the page's quadratic de-duplication cost 13 of the ~20 s it kept the main thread busy, and a logged-in user saw an empty "Show Instant" table for ~4.8 minutes while 278 throttled availability requests ran. It is also the list Firefox users reported blank while it opened in Chrome: its 1,981,649-character iframe URL is past Firefox's 1,048,572 (Firefox 157), under Chrome's 2 MiB. |
| `old-form-urls.txt`                                 | The `<iframe src>` of the 16 pages in `https://hashlists.debridmediamanager.com` published through the old `{url}` body after `{data}` was deployed (2026-09-30 00:40 UTC), from `22cdc626-68ab-4a6d-925b-ca81996a812a` (2026-09-30 03:58 UTC) to `d1bb7cb0-b5b6-4c26-a7ff-12cbda4b6308` (2026-10-03 13:48 UTC), one per line, byte for byte. | Every shape a client really sends as `url`: `https://debridmediamanager.com/hashlist#` and an lz-string hash list, 260 to 6,744 characters. `/api/hashlists` accepts exactly that shape and refuses any other `url`, because it used to write the url into the published page as it came.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
